design_philosophy: A 'Control Room' aesthetic designed for high-visibility, rapid threat assessment, and data density. The UI must feel authoritative, precise, and highly functional. Employs a strict 'Technical Grid' with exposed 1px borders, sharp edges, and flat surfaces. No soft shadows; relies on stark contrasts and color-coded indicators.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense but strictly organized. Utilize 'The Control Room Grid' protocol.
spacing_and_layout.grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 or gap-6
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data and logs. Top-right for status indicators.

buttons.styles: font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-sm font-semibold transition-colors duration-200

inputs.classes: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#27272A] text-white rounded-sm focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF] focus:border-[#007AFF] font-mono text-sm

navigation.style: Compact left sidebar or highly dense top navigation with glassmorphism (bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#27272A]).

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimalist, mechanical, and precise. No bouncy animations.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Instant color swaps or subtle border highlights (150ms ease-in-out).
motion_and_interactions.live_indicators: Blinking opacity animation (pulse) for 'LIVE' badges or recording dots.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in with a very slight upward slide (duration: 200ms).

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, sharp geometry to match the tactical theme.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="live-feed-camera-1"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for all icons to match the tactical, crisp feel.
Implement 'The Control Room Grid' for the main dashboard: a high-density bento grid where every pixel is utilized. No gaping white/black spaces between widgets.
Do NOT use soft shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders (border-[#27272A]) to separate elements.
Use JetBrains Mono for timestamps, metric numbers, and confidence scores (e.g., 'CONFIDENCE: 98%').
For the Sentinel AI chat, use the Volt Blue (#007AFF) for the AI's messages/accents to distinguish it from standard system alerts.
Ensure the layout is responsive but prioritizes a dense data view on large screens.
All cards/widgets should have `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`, avoiding modern rounded UI bubbles.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, link, and interactive widget.
